g.text: Preconditions: Student is signed in and has a charging-request reference.
Service calls use the signed-in Student's identity.
[owned record retrieved and not already Cancelled]
[owned record exists but is not cancellable]
[record unavailable, read failed, already Cancelled or not cancellable]
End this attempt; no new cancellation or resource release.
Pending without an allocation: cancellation does not change charging-point capacity.
[Recheck charging request and cancel its allocation]
Mark Cancelled and release any future charging allocation once.
Pending without allocation does not change capacity. Already Cancelled returns existing result.
Never update the associated parking booking or session.
Smart E-Mobility Hub | Submission 2 | Parking & Private EVs
Thin rectangle: execution of a responsibility; nested rectangle: nested execution
Solid arrow: request / action | Dashed arrow: returned result
Activation ends before waiting for Student input. Read guards top to bottom.
critical: required consistency boundary; updates are all-or-none as noted
